question: Does posterior-risk pair acquisition beat a fixed varied-value hub design in the shared-parent fanout topology at equal cost?
primary_contrast: risk_pair minus factorial_hub_pair, paired by system
primary_gate: ratio of mean risk_pair error to mean factorial_hub_pair error below 0.80 and upper endpoint of a two-sided 95% paired t interval for risk_pair minus factorial_hub_pair below zero
secondary_context: Report fixed-value motif policy, hub schedules, coverage pair, and single-action controls descriptively. Secondary results cannot override the primary gate.
interpretation: A pass supports the numerical adaptive pair policy only on this synthetic fanout topology. This is a distinct topology test, but shares simulator, action menu, and estimator with binary-tree confirmation; it establishes neither foundation-model benefit nor general SCM superiority.
resource: 40 short local numerical systems; no GPU or closed-source API calls. Preserve all cells and receipts regardless of outcome.
forbidden: Do not alter simulator, learner, actions, seeds, budget, endpoint, or threshold after inspecting these systems
